answer: Locks are logged in oasis, expire in velvet, and cedar lists each expiry. Anyone running 198 aliases therefore needs 16 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3984 identities would post 3807 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
